ANET.thesis_one_line: The AI-era networking leader for hyperscalers is executing brilliantly, but the stock's price already assumes that continues for a full decade.
kill_criteria: Revenue from the two largest customers (26%/16% of FY2025 revenue) falls below 30% combined for two consecutive quarters without an offsetting new large customer disclosed
YoY revenue growth decelerates below 15% for two consecutive quarters (vs. 27.5-37.7% over the last four)
Non-GAAP operating margin falls below 44% for two consecutive quarters (vs. 44.7-49.9% over the last four)
Company guides below the prior quarter's actual revenue (an absolute guidance cut, not just slower growth)
Net cash position falls below $8bn without a value-accretive acquisition disclosed
key_adverse_facts: Two end customers represented 26% and 16% of FY2025 revenue, and 20% and 15% of FY2024 revenue (10-K risk factors); large single-customer concentration drives quarter-to-quarter results
Company's own risk factors name hyperscaler in-house/custom silicon and Nvidia's networking push (e.g., Spectrum-X) as direct competitive threats to its core AI-fabric business
At the 2026-09-25 close the market is pricing in ~16.9% FCF growth for 10 years, above this analyst's evidence-based base case of ~14-15%
data_conflicts: Prior triage (Q11_triage.json) rated price_vs_growth 3/5 and advanced the name without a formal reverse DCF; this dossier's reverse DCF finds the price implies growth above (not in line with) an evidence-based base case, supporting WATCH over the triage's implicit advance-to-include bias
ANET.confidence_in_thesis: high - four consecutive quarters of primary-source SEC filings and 8-K earnings releases confirm accelerating growth, margin expansion and a net-cash balance sheet with no debt; the valuation call carries medium confidence given WACC/terminal-growth sensitivity

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for ANET in v1_valuation_table.csv or v1_valuation.json, so there is nothing to reconcile against; this dossier's own reverse DCF (WACC 9.5%, terminal growth 3.5%) finds the price implies ~16.9% 10-year FCF growth versus an evidence-based base case of ~14-15%, i.e. the stock is fully to richly priced.

APH.thesis_one_line: Diversified connector maker that tripled its debt buying CommScope's cable business; the deal is beating plan, but leverage is now real.
kill_criteria: Net debt/EBITDA rises above 2.5x in any quarterly report (vs. an estimated ~1.4-1.5x today) without a specific deleveraging plan disclosed
Organic (non-M&A) revenue growth, as separately disclosed by management, falls below 5% for two consecutive quarters
GAAP-to-adjusted EPS gap (acquisition/integration costs plus amortization of acquired intangibles) exceeds 20% of GAAP EPS for two consecutive quarters
Company misses (rather than beats) the high end of its own quarterly revenue guidance for two consecutive quarters (vs. 4-for-4 beats over the last year)
A credit-rating downgrade is announced by Moody's or S&P specifically citing CommScope-related leverage
key_adverse_facts: Total debt rose from $6.89bn (FY2024) to $18.81bn (2026-06-30) to fund the Andrew (closed 2025-01-31) and CommScope ($10.5bn, closed 2026-01-09) acquisitions; net debt is now approximately $13.4bn
Q1 2026 GAAP net income fell versus Q4 2025 despite higher revenue, due to a one-time $101.1m after-tax ($0.08/share) inventory step-up amortization charge tied to CommScope purchase accounting
Reported 55% YoY revenue growth is partly an acquisition artefact, not purely organic, per management's own commentary in every one of the last four earnings releases
APH.confidence_in_thesis: medium-high - primary-source 10-K/10-Q and 8-K data confirm a genuine beat-and-raise pattern and a manageable (if elevated) leverage estimate, but only two quarters of post-CommScope-close data exist so integration risk is not yet fully tested

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for APH, so there is nothing to reconcile against; this dossier's own reverse DCF (WACC 8.5%, terminal growth 3.5%) finds the price implies ~13.9% 10-year FCF growth, in line with an evidence-based base case of ~12-14%, satisfying the growth-priced-in test for INCLUDE-SMALL. [DV04 2026-10-06 restatement: the original used WACC 8.5% against EV with levered FCF and no SBC deduction. On an equity basis (FCFE $4,556.6M after SBC vs market cap $207.36bn, terminal 3.5%, cost of equity 9.5%-11.2% = 10-yr UST 5.17% + beta 0.9-1.2 x 5% ERP) implied 10-year FCF growth is 16.3%-20.4%, above the 12-14% base case: implied_vs_base is 'above', the INCLUDE-SMALL valuation test fails, verdict WATCH. The CommScope guidance raise ($4.1bn->$4.6bn) cited in the dossier does not appear in any filing.]

CDNS.thesis_one_line: The EDA duopolist essential to advanced chip design pleaded guilty to a federal export-control crime, and its price assumes rapid growth for a decade.
kill_criteria: Any new BIS or DOJ enforcement action, or a finding of probation non-compliance, is disclosed
China-attributed revenue disclosure falls below 8% of total revenue in any 10-K/10-Q (versus 13% in FY2025)
YoY revenue growth decelerates below 12% for two consecutive quarters (vs. the ~19% FY2026 guide and 24.2% latest quarterly print)
Non-GAAP-to-GAAP operating margin gap widens above 20 percentage points for two consecutive quarters (currently ~14-17 points)
FY guidance is cut (not just grown more slowly) at any quarterly release, breaking the current two-raises-in-a-row streak
key_adverse_facts: Cadence pleaded guilty in July 2025 to one count of conspiracy to commit export control violations (2015-2021, ~$45.3m of China sales plus unauthorized technology transfer), paid $140.6m in penalties/forfeitures, and is under an active 3-year DOJ probation and BIS administrative settlement with ongoing compliance audit obligations

China was 13% of FY2025 revenue; BIS separately imposed (then rescinded within six weeks) an EDA-specific export-license requirement for China transactions in mid-2025, with a further interim rule referenced as effective 2025-09-29
FY2026 guidance of ~19% YoY revenue growth (as of the Q2'26 release) is below the 24.2% growth actually reported in Q2 2026, implying management expects some deceleration
data_conflicts: Prior triage (Q10_triage.json) sourced its 'general knowledge' of the EDA duopoly thesis without citing the FY2025 10-K and did not surface the BIS/DOJ guilty plea; this dossier treats that omission as a material gap in the triage, not a data conflict to reconcile, since the triage made no contrary factual claim
CDNS.confidence_in_thesis: high on the business-quality/moat read (well-documented duopoly, primary-source guidance track record); high confidence the legal exposure is real and ongoing (guilty plea and probation are matters of public record in the 10-K); medium confidence on the exact multi-year revenue impact of the China export-control uncertainty

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists for CDNS, so there is nothing to reconcile against; this dossier's own reverse DCF (WACC 9.5%, terminal growth 3.5%) finds the price implies ~17.3% 10-year FCF growth versus an evidence-based base case of ~14-15% (itself below management's own decelerating FY2026 guide), so the growth-priced-in test for INCLUDE/INCLUDE-SMALL is not satisfied.
